title: Dale DevHost topology file
description: The dev profile of a logic configuration: logic-block instances and explicit interface wiring, with contract mappings optional (unlisted contracts get DevHost mocks). The generic structural schema shipped with Vion.Dale.DevHost; 'dale dev --export-topology' writes a C#-built preset in this shape. Parsing is strict (unknown fields are rejected), so this schema catches wrong field names in hand edits.

id.description: URL-safe slug, no '..'; must match the file name (<id>.topology.json). 'schema' is reserved (GET /api/topologies/schema). Scenario files reference it via "topology".

logicBlockInstances.description: The blocks in this topology; types are resolved against the loaded plugin assemblies.

typeFullName.description: Full type name of the LogicBlock (resolved from the loaded assemblies).

name.description: Instance name, unique within the topology. No '.', which scenario name paths split on.

instantiationParameters.description: Operator-chosen [InstantiationParameter] values (identifier -> JSON scalar; enums as member-name strings), applied to the block before Configure so config-time inclusion gates resolve. Any JSON scalar the parameter's own declared type decodes, so a numeric parameter takes a fractional value. null is accepted only for a parameter whose declared type is nullable. Optional.

interfaceMappings.description: Explicit logic-block interface wiring, applied verbatim (not re-discovered). Source and target names must be declared instances.

contractPairings.description: Pairs of service-provider contract endpoints declared as ONE wire — each side's captured outbound is delivered as the other side's inbound, so a simulator block bound to a provider face closes the loop a real service provider would. Keyed on (block, contract binding), not on endpoint triples. Symmetric: which directions materialise is derived from the two handlers' [ScenarioWire] types and validated when the host loads the topology.

contractMappings.description: Optional explicit hardware-contract endpoint mappings; unlisted contracts are auto-mocked. Field names match `dale dev --export-config` (the 'mapped' prefix), so the two shapes no longer diverge.

contractIdentifier.description: A service-provider contract binding on that instance.
